description: Consolidate duplicated validation-target test assertion helpers into pkg/testutil/validationassert and retarget API, service, and factory-validation tests with no production or validation-semantics change.

context.customerAsk: As part of pkg/ duplication cleanup (customer ask 11), move repeated assertHasValidationTarget and assertHasValidationTargetCode helpers into one shared test-only package and retarget API and service test call sites so validation topology tests share the same assertions without changing runtime behavior.
context.problem: The same validation-target presence checks are copy-pasted across pkg/api, pkg/service, and pkg/factory/validation tests with risk of divergent matching rules and harder review of topology validation regressions.
context.solution: Add canonical helpers in pkg/testutil/validationassert for API-shaped (factoryapi.FactoryValidationTarget) and domain-shaped (factoryvalidation.Target) slices, retarget all scoped test call sites, remove duplicate local definitions, and prove behavior neutrality by running existing validation topology test suites unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria: pkg/testutil/validationassert exports canonical API and domain validation-target assertion helpers with unchanged match semantics

Duplicate assertHasValidationTarget, assertHasValidationTargetCode, assertHasTargetCode, and assertHasTargetSubject definitions are removed from scoped pkg/api, pkg/service, and pkg/factory/validation test files
All retargeted tests assert the same validation codes, subject types, subject ids, and locations as before consolidation
go test ./pkg/api/... ./pkg/service/... ./pkg/factory/validation/... passes with no production package importing validationassert
No production API, CLI, UI, or OpenAPI schema changes are introduced in this lane
Typecheck, lint, and the scoped test suites above pass (quality gate)
